ui.agentMessages.settings.share_typing.d.context_note: Explains what the switch shares (only the fact that you are typing) and states that the draft text is never shared. Quote the indicator wording with the locale's usual quotation marks.

findings.issue: Quote marks stored reversed (U+201D … U+201C). ur style guide sets “ ” in logical order and every other ur catalogue string stores “…” (e.g. “{name}”); the bidi algorithm mirrors placement, not glyph choice.

notes: Catalogue audit only: no rendered-fit or native-render claim. Mechanical checks above were executed by scratch build.py in the auditor session; findings are the auditor's linguistic judgement against glossary + style guide.
